context: Windows 1.1.0 Sandbox Start completion after ctrld SCM fix
claim: DirectInternetMethodSvc kept action-status at running after Start-Direct.ps1 had exited because redirected stdout/stderr pipe handles were inherited by long-lived winws.exe; ReadToEndAsync therefore never observed EOF.

evidence.detail: product Status=ACTIVE/healthy; YouTube=204, OpenAI=401, GitHub=200; action-status still running.
DirectInternetMethodSvc, ctrld.exe and winws.exe present; no pwsh.exe remained.
action-begin:start exists, no action-end/action-timeout despite pwsh exit.
service redirects PowerShell stdout/stderr, starts ReadToEndAsync, waits for process exit, then awaits stream reads; Start-Direct launches long-lived winws as descendant.

rootCause: Long-lived descendant inherited redirected OS standard handles, extending pipe lifetime beyond the lifecycle PowerShell process.
decision: Remove OS-level stdout/stderr redirection from privileged lifecycle PowerShell process; completion is exit-code based. Keep detailed lifecycle evidence in existing evidence JSON files/service log instead of pipe capture.
risk: Without captured streams, action-status error text becomes generic unless evidence is consulted; acceptable because detailed runtime/stop evidence already exists and avoiding deadlock is higher priority.
